english.title: Vehicle keeper - fail to give information to Chief Constable
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the keeper of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was alleged to have been used on a road

(A)_[without a vehicle licence in contravention of section 29]_
(B)_[in excess of the authority of a trade licence in contravention of section 34]_
(C)_[without the higher rate of duty having been paid in contravention of section 37]_

of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994, failed to give such information as to the identity of the

(D)_[driver]_
(E)_[user]_

of the said vehicle as you were required to give by or on behalf of the

(F)_[Chief Officer of Police for **(..SPECIFY FORCE..)]_
(G)_[Secretary of State]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 46(4) and (5) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.
